newsitem.title: JAPAN: DKB asset management firms say to merge in October.
newsitem.headline: DKB asset management firms say to merge in October.

text.p: Three investment management companies in the Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) group said on Tuesday that they would merge on October 1.
The three firms are Asahi Investment Trust Management Co, Kankaku Capital Management Co and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Investment Management Co, an affiliate of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank.
Kankaku Capital and Asahi Investment are affiliates of Kankaku Securities Co Ltd, which is part of the Dai-Ichi Kangyo group.

The three companies said in a statement that the planned merger would be aimed at providing better asset management services to both individual and corporate clients in line with Japan's "Big Bang" financial reforms.
To prepare for the planned merger, the three will set up a committee shortly, they said.
Under the merger agreement, Asahi Investment Trust will continue to exist and will absorb the two other firms, they said.
Combined managed assets at the three firms total 2.59 trillion yen, they said in the statement. Their combined operating profits totalled 11.02 billion yen in the business year ended March 31, 1996.
Asahi Investment mainly targets individuals, while the other two firms manage assets for pension funds and other institutional investors.
